piso_garantizado.evidencia: No penalty may restrict medical care, basic sustenance, freedom of movement, or ability to gather food for personal survival.

trabajo_segun_capacidad.evidencia: Every participant has an obligation to contribute to collective survival according to their capacity, taking into account health and physical limitations.

medicamentos_segun_necesidad.evidencia: Every participant has the right to medical care from the shared medicines, distributed according to need as decided by absolute majority.

cargo_de_una_sola_parte.evidencia: The group is governed by an elected Coordinator, chosen by absolute majority.

cargo_electo.evidencia: The group is governed by an elected Coordinator, chosen by absolute majority.

cargo_revocable.evidencia: The Coordinator may be removed at any time by absolute majority vote.

decide_el_conjunto.evidencia: The Coordinator has no unilateral authority over medicines, the boat, or resources.
